# Lawrence Energy Services Limited (LESL)

> Turnkey electrical and mechanical engineering contractors in Nigeria since 2009. Over 400 MW installed capacity, 100,000 accident-free man-hours, and trusted alliances with Cummins West Africa, Clarke Energy Ltd, and 7up Bottling Company.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/): Overview of turnkey industrial engineering, power plant installations, and corporate credentials.
- [About Us](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/about): Company history, executive leadership, safety records, and organizational structure.
- [All Services](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/services): Engineering capabilities across power generation, substations, mechanical piping, and consultancy.
- [Our Projects](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/projects): Verified engineering installations delivered across Nigeria with technical specifications.
- [Visual Gallery](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/gallery): High-resolution photographic gallery of commissioned power plants and substation works.
- [Clients & Partners](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/partners): Technical alliances including Cummins West Africa, Clarke Energy, and Seven-Up Bottling Company.
- [Careers](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/careers): Engineering job openings, apprenticeship programs, and field safety culture.
- [Contact](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/contact): Direct contact details for our Lagos headquarters, technical support, and map coordinates.
- [Request a Quote](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/quote): Detailed request form for electrical and mechanical turnkey project estimates.
- [Book Consultation](https://lesl-energy-website.vercel.app/book): Schedule direct technical consultations with our senior engineering leadership.
